name: Step-Audio-Edit
intro: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark 是一个用于可控语音合成的综合评测框架，专注于情感、说话风格和副语言等细粒度属性。该基准随 Step-Audio-EditX 模型一同发布，后者是一个基于大语言模型的音频编辑模型。此评测框架的提出旨在解决现有评测方法在全面性上的不足。
build_method: 双语提示构建, 多语料说话者采样, 零样本声音克隆
eval_feature: 情感与风格分类, 副语言1至3分评分, 遗漏检查
build_method_en: Bilingual prompt construction, multi-corpus speaker sampling, zero-shot voice cloning
eval_feature_en: Emotion and style classification, paralinguistic 1-3 rating, omission checks
intro_en: Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark is a comprehensive evaluation framework for controllable speech synthesis, focusing on fine-grained attributes such as emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistics. The benchmark is released alongside the Step-Audio-EditX model, an audio editing model based on large language models. This evaluation framework aims to address the limitations of existing methods in terms of comprehensiveness.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Step-Audio-EditX Technical Report arXiv:2511.03601 Section 5.1; official stepfun-ai/Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark repository. Step-Audio-Edit-Benchmark evaluates emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistic control with zero-shot voice cloning. Its eight speakers comprise two male and two female speakers per language: Chinese voices from Wenet-Speech4TTS and English voices from GLOBE-V2 and Libri-Light. The emotion set has five categories and 50 content-matched Chinese plus 50 English prompts per category. The speaking-style set has seven categories with the same per-language count and target-matched content. Ten paralinguistic labels each have 50 relevant LLM-generated Chinese and 50 English samples. Crossing the 2,200 bilingual text samples with four speakers per language produces 8,800 evaluation audios. Gemini-2.5-Pro classifies emotion among five choices and style among seven; category accuracy is averaged across speakers. For paralinguistics it applies a dedicated 1-to-3 rubric, explicitly checking required event insertion and omission, and the benchmark reports the overall mean judge score.
